name: Synthesizer
shortDescription: Voltage-controlled electronic instrument generating and sculpting sound from oscillators, filters, and amplifiers.
description: A synthesizer generates sound electronically through a signal path: Oscillator (VCO) → Filter (VCF) → Amplifier (VCA), each controlled by voltage. Oscillators generate primitive waveforms (sine, saw, square, triangle, noise). Filters shape the harmonic content. The amplifier controls dynamics. Envelope generators (ADSR) define how each stage changes over time. LFOs (Low Frequency Oscillators) add modulation like vibrato or tremolo.
historicalOrigins: Robert Moog commercialised the voltage-controlled synthesizer in 1964. Wendy Carlos's 'Switched-On Bach' (1968) demonstrated its musicality. Sequential Circuits Prophet-5 (1978) added polyphonic memory presets.
acousticPrinciples: VCO (Voltage-Controlled Oscillator): generates periodic waveforms at electrically-controlled frequencies
VCF (Voltage-Controlled Filter): subtractive synthesis — removes frequency bands from rich waveforms
VCA (Voltage-Controlled Amplifier): controls signal amplitude over time via ADSR envelope
ADSR: Attack (rise time), Decay (fall to sustain), Sustain (held level), Release (fade)

characteristics.dynamicRange: Defined by D/A converter bit depth; theoretically unlimited
characteristics.timbralColor: Infinitely variable: from pure sine to harsh distortion noise
characteristics.orchestralRole: Bass line, lead melody, pad textures, FX, sound design

soundDNA.exciter: Voltage-controlled oscillator generating primitive periodic or random waveforms
soundDNA.resonator: Voltage-controlled low-pass filter (VCF) — Moog ladder or state-variable topology
soundDNA.harmonics: Filter cutoff + resonance shape harmonic emphasis
soundDNA.attackDecay: ADSR envelope fully configurable; 0ms to infinite sustain
soundDNA.timbreProfile: Infinitely malleable: bright leads, warm pads, metallic FM bells
soundDNA.radiationPattern: Electronic — depends on speaker or headphone configuration

keys.label: MIDI Keyboard
keys.function: 61-key velocity-sensitive keyboard sending MIDI note-on/off and velocity data.

characteristics.material: Plastic/rubber key mechanisms with velocity sensors
characteristics.mechanism: MIDI voltage: key down = note number + velocity byte

oscillator_section.label: VCO (Oscillator)
oscillator_section.function: Two or more voltage-controlled oscillators generating saw, square, sine, and triangle waveforms.

characteristics.material: Analogue: discrete transistor tempco-compensated VCO; Digital: FPGA waveform generator
characteristics.mechanism: Controlled frequency oscillation; waveform selection adds harmonic content

filter_section.label: VCF (Filter)
filter_section.function: Resonant low-pass, high-pass, or band-pass filter shaping harmonic content in real time.

characteristics.material: Moog ladder: cascaded transistor pairs; or OTA topology
characteristics.mechanism: Cutoff frequency (fc) removes harmonics above/below threshold; Q adds resonant peak

amp_section.label: VCA & ADSR Envelope
amp_section.function: Voltage-controlled amplifier with ADSR envelope shaping note dynamics over time.

characteristics.mechanism: Gain = f(ADSR CV); Attack = rise time, Decay = fall, Sustain = level, Release = fade

knobs.label: Control Knobs & Sliders
knobs.function: Rotary potentiometers and faders directly control VCO pitch, VCF cutoff, resonance, ADSR times.

characteristics.material: Conductive plastic rotary pots and linear faders
characteristics.mechanism: Voltage divider output scales CV input to target parameter

display.label: Display & Patch Memory
display.function: LCD/OLED display shows patch name, oscilloscope view, and parameter values for stored presets.

characteristics.material: LCD matrix or OLED screen panel
characteristics.mechanism: Patch: parameter values stored in NVRAM, recalled by preset number

followTheSound.title: MIDI Note On
followTheSound.explanation: Key strike sends MIDI note number and velocity. Voltage-controlled oscillator receives CV pitch.

followTheSound.title: Waveform Generation
followTheSound.explanation: VCO generates raw sawtooth/square/sine waveform at MIDI-specified frequency.

followTheSound.title: Subtractive Filtering
followTheSound.explanation: VCF removes harmonics above cutoff frequency. Resonance peak emphasises harmonics at fc.

followTheSound.title: ADSR Dynamics
followTheSound.explanation: VCA shapes amplitude over time: Attack rise → Decay fall → Sustain hold → Release fade.
